items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: We played... We played for Martin Borman in the old St. Charles Hotel frame building.

ctx.x: Well, sometime Nick LaRocca told about that you used to have some of the men put potatoes in the horns. Do you remember that? Well...

The fellas that couldn't play? I'll tell you what happened. We played... We played for Martin Borman in the old St. Charles Hotel frame building. You understand? Yeah. And it was his campaign, running for mayor. My first daughter mayor. Was it Alfred put Limburger cheese in...
